31275.a:
```sh
find /etc -name "*.conf"
find / -xdev -type f -size +500M 2>/dev/null     # katta fayllar, boshqa FS'ga o'tmasdan
find /var/log -type f -mtime +30                   # 30 kundan eski
find . -mmin -10                                   # 10 daqiqada o'zgargan
find /home -user ali -type d
find / -perm -4000 -type f 2>/dev/null             # SUID fayllar (audit)
find . -maxdepth 1 -empty
```
`-mtime +30` — 30 kundan **ko'p**, `-30` — kam. `2>/dev/null` — Permission denied shovqini.

31276.a:
| Vosita | Manba | Tezlik | Aniqlik |
|---|---|---|---|
| `find` | FS'ni aylanadi | sekin | real |
| `locate`/`plocate` | `updatedb` DB | juda tez | eskirgan bo'lishi mumkin |
| `which` | `PATH` | tez | faqat binary |
| `type` | shell (alias, builtin ham) | tez | eng to'g'ri |
| `whereis` | standart dir'lar | tez | binary+man |

Yangi yaratilgan faylni `locate` topmaydi — `sudo updatedb`.

31277.a:
```sh
find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \;     # 10 000 fayl = 10 000 rm
find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} +      # bir necha rm
find . -name "*.tmp" -delete
find /var/log -name "*.log" -mtime +7 -exec gzip {} +
```
**Gotcha:** `-delete` **oxirida** bo'lishi shart: `find . -delete -name "*.tmp"` — hamma narsani o'chiradi! Avval `-print` bilan sinab ko'r, keyin `-delete`.

`-exec` fayl nomini xavfsiz uzatadi (bo'shliq, qator ko'chishi muammo emas).

31278.a:
```sh
find . -name "*.log" | xargs gzip
cat hosts | xargs -I{} ssh {} uptime
echo a b c | xargs -n1 echo          # har biri alohida
xargs -P 8 -n 1 curl -sO < urls.txt  # 8 parallel
```
- `rm *` — `Argument list too long` (ARG_MAX). `find ... | xargs rm` — bo'lib beradi.
- `-I{}` — har elementga bitta buyruq va joyiga qo'yish.
- `-r` (GNU) — bo'sh kirishda buyruqni ishga tushirmaslik (`xargs rm` bo'sh — xato yoki kutilmagan amal).
- `-t` — bajarilayotganni ko'rsatish.

31279.a:
```sh
find . -name "*.txt" | xargs rm             # 'my' va 'file.txt' — XATO, xavfli
find . -name "*.txt" -print0 | xargs -0 rm  # to'g'ri
find . -type f -print0 | xargs -0 -P4 -n50 sha256sum
```
NUL (`\0`) — fayl nomida bo'lishi mumkin bo'lmagan yagona belgi. `grep -lZ`, `git ls-files -z`, `sort -z` ham NUL bilan ishlaydi.

Security: hujumchi `foo\n/etc/passwd` nomli fayl yaratsa, `-0`'siz skript `/etc/passwd`ga amal qilishi mumkin.

31280.a:
```sh
tar czf backup.tar.gz /etc /var/www       # yaratish + gzip
tar tzf backup.tar.gz | head               # ichini ko'rish
tar xzf backup.tar.gz -C /restore          # ochish
tar xzf backup.tar.gz etc/nginx/nginx.conf # bitta fayl
tar --zstd -cf b.tar.zst dir/
tar czf - dir | ssh host 'tar xzf - -C /dst'   # stream orqali ko'chirish
```
`tar` — arxivlaydi (ko'p fayl -> bitta), siqish — gzip/xz/zstd. Zamonaviy GNU tar ochishda siqishni o'zi aniqlaydi (`tar xf`).

31281.a:
| Format | Siqish | Tezlik | Qachon |
|---|---|---|---|
| gzip | o'rta | tez | log, HTTP, universal |
| bzip2 | yaxshi | sekin | eski |
| xz | eng yaxshi | juda sekin | release tarball, bir marta siqib ko'p yuklash |
| zstd | yaxshi | juda tez, parallel | backup, log, konteyner layer |
| zip | o'rta | tez | Windows, random access |

```sh
zstd -T0 -19 big.sql        # barcha yadro
pigz -p 8 big.log           # parallel gzip
```
Allaqachon siqilgan (jpg, mp4, .gz) — qayta siqish foydasiz.

31282.a:
**Himoya:**
- Avval ko'r: `tar tf x.tar | head`, `unzip -l x.zip`.
- Bo'sh katalogga och: `mkdir out && tar xf x.tar -C out`.
- GNU tar default `/` ni olib tashlaydi va `..` dan ogohlantiradi; root sifatida ochma (`--no-same-owner` user'da default).
- Kodda (Go/Java) arxiv ochishda har yo'lni `filepath.Clean` + prefiks tekshiruv — **Zip Slip** (CVE'lar ko'p).
- Hajm/fayl soni limiti — zip bomb.

```go
p := filepath.Join(dst, h.Name)
if !strings.HasPrefix(p, filepath.Clean(dst)+string(os.PathSeparator)) { return errBadPath }
```

31283.a:
```sh
tar --acls --xattrs --numeric-owner -cpf - /srv/data \
  | zstd -T0 -3 \
  | tee >(sha256sum > data.tar.zst.sha256) \
  > /backup/data.tar.zst
```
- `-p`, `--numeric-owner` — restore boshqa host'da UID to'g'ri.
- Izchillik: ishlayotgan ilova fayllari o'zgaradi (`file changed as we read it`) — LVM/FS snapshot'dan arxivla.
- DB — `pg_dump`/`pg_basebackup`, fayl nusxasi emas.
- Inkremental: `tar --listed-incremental`, yoki restic/borg (dedup, shifrlash).
- **Restore test qilinmagan backup — backup emas.**

31284.a:
```sh
find / -xdev \( -path /proc -o -path /sys -o -path /var/lib/docker \) -prune -o -name "*.pem" -print
rg -l "password" /etc            # ripgrep, parallel
fd -e log -S +100M /var          # fd
plocate nginx.conf               # indeks
```
- Arzon test'lar oldinda: `-name` (metadata), `-newer`, keyin `-exec grep`.
- NFS ustida find — juda sekin; serverda bajarish.
- Arxitektura darajasi: millionlab mayda fayl — inode tugashi, backup sekin; object storage yoki DB'ga ko'chirish kerakmi — o'shani so'ra.
